recipe.title: Recipe
recipe.help: What one unit of this size consumes. Waste % is added once. Give a line a slot (e.g. milk) so a replace group (e.g. Oat Milk) can swap it.
recipe.empty: No ingredients: this size will not deduct any stock.
recipe.pickIngredient: Choose an ingredient on every line.
recipe.wasteInvalid: Waste must be a number from 0 to 100.
recipe.slotInvalid: A slot uses letters, numbers, - or _ only.
recipe.slotMissing: The group “{{group}}” replaces the slot “{{slot}}”, but this recipe has no line with that slot.

modifiers.help: Reusable option groups. Link them to products on the product page.
modifiers.saveFirst: Save the group to add options.
modifiers.slotHint: The slot key used in recipes, e.g. milk.
modifiers.slotWarningsText: These sizes have no recipe line with the slot “{{slot}}”, so selling this group with them fails
modifiers.label: Option
modifiers.sizePricesHint: Overrides the extra price for one size.
modifiers.effectsHint: What this option consumes. “All sizes” applies when a size has no row of its own. An option with no rows changes nothing (a replace group then removes the slot, e.g. No milk).

pos.priceChangedText: Prices changed since you built this order. Review the new total, then take payment again.
pos.noShift: No open shift. Open your shift to start selling.

pos.lowStock: Low stock (the sale still goes through):
